featured_reviews.review_text: Had an amazing time at SHOTT Mumbai! The bowling, arcade games, and overall vibe were fantastic. featured_reviews.name: Chandu B
featured_reviews.review_text: Extremely disappointing experience. The staff aggressively pushes you to buy a game card with a minimum recharge of ₹3,100 instead of clearly explaining the available options. The combo packages are poorly designed and misleading they ended up charging us more than the advertised combo prices. To make matters worse, one of the combos included “5 arcade games,” but the card only worked on a limited selection of arcade machines. Many of the games we actually wanted to play either weren’t covered by the combo or weren’t functional at all. Paying a premium only to find several machines out of service made the experience feel like terrible value for money. Definitely not what you’d expect from a place that’s marketed as a premium entertainment destination. Most of the 5 stars reviews are definitely fake!

featured_reviews.name: Sneha Rajeshirke
featured_reviews.review_text: Best experience and worth it. Had so much fun with friends. Also the staff is very humble and helpful.

featured_reviews.name: Aishwarya chellath
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a really good experience . The vibe is great, music was nice, and the staff was super friendly and attentive. Food and drinks were fresh and well presented. Perfect place to chill with friends and have a fun evening. Would definitely visit again!

featured_reviews.name: Pratap Vashodiya
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited Shott Mumbai and had an amazing time playing their arcade games. The place has a lively vibe with a wide variety of games, from racing and shooting to classic arcade machines. What made my experience even more exciting was winning bonus tickets while playing. The thrill of collecting tickets after each win kept me fully engaged and added a fun competitive edge. Eventually, I redeemed my tickets and got a cool gift, which made the whole experience even more rewarding. The staff was friendly and helpful, guiding me through the games and redemption process. Overall, it was a fun-filled and memorable outing, perfect for hanging out with friends or just enjoying some solo gaming time. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for entertainment in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.review_text: It was our first time for Bowling. There is no prior reservation required it is first come first serve basis. It was a fun experience though and you can visit with ur friends here. On one bowling track four players can play together. There is screen above which tells u about score among players. featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience at Game Palacio. The overall vibe of the place is great, but the service completely ruined it for us.

The staff (Sumit) was extremely rude and unprofessional. We were pressured to place our food order because the staff wanted to close the kitchen — even though it was still one hour before the official closing time. Very disappointed with the service experience. Would think twice before visiting again.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing time at Dave & Buster’s, Infiniti Mall (Andheri West)!
The place is absolutely massive — around 22,000 sq. ft. of pure fun and food. The ambience is super high-energy — part carnival, part sports bar, part social lounge. You’ll find zones for arcade games, VR experiences, Nitro Bowling with cool lighting, hi-tech darts, and big screens showing live cricket, football & F1. Perfect for birthdays, group hangouts, or even a casual fun evening.
We tried quite a few things from the menu:
🥤 Dare Devil Mocktail, Fight Mode Mocktail, Purple Breeze Mocktail, Oreo Shake – all refreshing and perfectly balanced.
🍕 Farmhouse Flatbread (Veg) – crisp and loaded with toppings.
🍗 Chicken Wings and Game Day Grub Platter (Non-Veg) – juicy, flavorful, and great for sharing.
🍔 Brekky Smash Chicken Burger – one of the best!
🌯 Veg Paneer Wrap and Creamy Garden Pasta – delicious and satisfying.
🍫 Tiramisu & Smoor Chocolate Cheesecake were the perfect sweet endings.
They’ve got a dedicated food & snack area, VR and arcade sections, bowling lanes, and live sports screening, making it one of the best entertainment spots in Andheri West.
Service was quick, staff were friendly, and the overall vibe was fun and energetic.
💡 Tip: Come in groups, buy a game card, and spend some time exploring — it’s totally worth it!
Highly recommend for anyone looking to combine great food, drinks, and games under one roof. 🎮🍔🍹

featured_reviews.name: Estate Expert Ellie
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst birthday experience ever.

Despite booking and paying in advance for a table and a bowling alley, we faced constant pushing and overcrowding (dhakka-mukki) throughout the evening. I raised the issue multiple times in advance with both the lady and male bouncers, yet every complaint was ignored.

What are the basic needs for a place to be usable as a turf?

1. Ventilation
2. Real/fake grass
3. Ground should be clean of debries to avoid injuries
4. Covered, so items around doesn't get damaged
5. Animal free, to avoid interruption in gameplay
6. A place/bench to keep belongings

2. Concrete floor with green color carpet. Cz duelulu is solulu. Injury on fall doesn't matter.
3. Random spots with uneven surfaces. Wave pool.
4. Covered but items are inside:) one wrong shot and you'll break halogen lights costing 5-10k to fix
5. No animals. Just animal droppings (💩) in middle of the pitch.
6. Since it's a wedding all, you keep your belongings either inside the turf (you'll break it), in adjacent turf (someone else will break it) or outside the turf (finders keepers)

featured_reviews.review_text:
Rodeo Drive located on the first floor of the peninsula building, I went in the evening as the match was on and wanted to have some drinks and enjoy the same.

Overall it was a nice place would definitely give it a try once again with some friends.
